title: Quenched Gooey French Peanut Crepes
description: A charred and gooey French dish featuring roasted peanuts, perfect for a sick day, made in a nut-free-friendly environment and formed into crepes. This dish is a unique twist on traditional crepes.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the milk, water, eggs, and sugar until well combined.
Add the flour to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add the melted butter, peanut butter, and salt to the bowl and whisk until fully incorporated.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in a small amount of the batter.
Tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom with the batter.
Cook the crepe for 1-2 minutes, until the bottom is lightly browned.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook the other side of the crepe for 1 minute, until lightly browned.
Repeat the process with the remaining batter, until all the crepes are cooked.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked crepe on a plate and sprinkle with chopped roasted peanuts.
Drizzle with a small amount of peanut butter and serve immediately.
